sources.entry: Posio - Geography multiplayer game. MIT Python

summary.one_liner: Posio is a multiplayer geography game built with Django (GeoDjango), Django Channels, HTMX and Leaflet.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a multiplayer geography game served as a Django web application. It uses Django Channels for real-time communication and HTMX for dynamic page updates, with Leaflet providing the map. Setup includes management commands that create a "cities" game and a "flags" game in the database. The README links to a live demo but does not detail gameplay rules or other features. Two run paths are documented: Docker Compose, or a local Python virtualenv with Spatialite and Redis.
use_cases: playing a multiplayer geography game in the browser
learning country and city locations on a map
hosting a Django Channels and HTMX example app
how_to_run: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
notable: Real-time multiplayer built on Django Channels
Ships with preset cities and flags game setup commands
Runs with Docker Compose or a local virtualenv
caveats: Non-Docker setup requires GeoDjango spatial dependencies, Spatialite and Redis installed separately
README does not describe gameplay rules or number of players supported
Tested with Python 3.12 per the README
